name: The recovered heart of M'uru
shortDescription: The recovered heart of M'uru, represented in the Shattered Sun and Sunwell research story.
body: The crystalline remnant Velen presents in the original raid epilogue; it is not the earlier whole M'uru/Entropius form. Original image-generation art; not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, size or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the Burning Crusade patch-2.4 client/model before human review. See docs/research/shattered-sun-sunwell-visual-assets.json.
